notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch notes of April 6th (Edited)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603447/58678739a38bcff1f747e679b5ba803fa05600e7.png[/img]

● Event ends <Burning Arcade>

● New Event <Temple of Monkey King> 
   - New Event Arcade "Temple of Monkey King" 
    *Available in the event period only
    *Needs Normal Arcade Ticket 1 to enter.
    *Clear rewards: Monkey King Costumes. 
    *April 6th ~ next update.

● New Item <Egg Series> 
    - Golden Egg I, II will be renewed to 14 Egg series. 
    - Warrior, Samurai, Gatchaman, Dark Avenger, Forest Keeper, Shinobi, Blaze, Magician, Monkey King, Death Scythe, Paladin, Rider, Gold Firer, Saw Blade Eggs. 
    - Only Unlimited costumes of Unique/Rare grade will be obtained from these eggs.
    - Previous Gold Firer Egg will not be available anymore.

● New Item <April Packages>
    - Limited period sales of 4 new packages. (50%~80% discounted price) 
    - Only 1 time purchasable per 1 character. 
    - Each packages contains <Coupon for April>, and you can exchange them with valuable items. 

● Sale ends <Syringe> 
    - Syringe Extra Large, Syringe Large are no longer available in cash shop. 

● Tower Mode Revampment
    - Map graphic design and the rules will be changed. 
      * Background of map and the look of Tower 
      * <Tower> will be separated into Main Tower and Sub Tower. 
      * The team who destroy the opposite team's tower will be the winner. 
      * To reach the main tower, you have to destroy 2 of Sub-towers first. 
      * Sub tower attacks the approaching enemies. 
      * If no one manage to destroy the main tower, the team who damaged the tower more will win. 

● New Ladder Season 2
     - Ladder, Arcade rank will be reset after end of Season 1 and the rewards will be given by ranks. 
      * Please refer the announcement about New Ladder season. 

● Others
     - Some of costumes' price will be slightly down. 
     - Opening "My shop" will be possible at level 30. 
     - "1:1 Trade" is available at level 30.
     - (Bug fix) Clone costume: Legendary costumes will be available for Clone Costume system.

notes.title: Patch notes of February 9th, 2017
notes.notes:
Patch notes 
2017, February 9th

● Event Close <Happy New Year Event>
  - Contents regarding to previous events was removed. 

● New Event <Valentine's day Event>
   1. Login Event
      Players can obtain Valentine's Costume and Valentine's Box item from Log-in Event. 
   2. Arcade Event
      During the event period, Chocolate and Candy will drop from every Arcades instead of HP/SP potion. 
      Also players can obtain Valentine Boxes in certain chance from every Arcades except Park Arcade. 
         Q What's inside? and How to open it? 
        →  A Valentine Box contains special items that you cannot usually get.  To open the box, you need a Valentine Key that you can buy from Cash Shop with 250 Cash. 
   
● New Items
  - New cash item: Gold Firer Egg
    Players can obtain one of below items in certain chance. 

    Rare / Unique Set Costume 9 Parts (Unlimited, 7Days) with Set bonuses
    Normal Arcade Tikets (5, 10, 20)
    My shop Viewer (1) 
    Super Mega Phones (2, 3, 5) 
    ORB Box +2 ~ +5 (1, 2, 3)
    ORB Box +5 ~ +10 (1, 2, 3)
    Blue Potion (30, 40, 50) 

● New Costumes: Pirate Costume Set
   → 6 Parts (Hair, Face, Shirts, Pants, Gloves, Shoes): Available from Item Shop.
   → Accessory Parts (Back, Hat, Ring): added on Lucky Egg
    Set bonus stats: 
     3 sets: Exp gain + 10%
     6 sets: Exp gain + 20%
     9 sets: Exp gain + 30%

● New Arcade <Hard Arcade> on Zone6
    - Higher difficulties, but able to get higher EXP and Zen rewards, also Higher grade of Costumes. 
    - Enter level: Character Level 30 or higher
    - Consumes 1 Hard Arcade ticket (Available from Item shop.) 

● Others
    - Daily Event [Tower Mode] schedule changed. (GMT+9)
       Weekdays: 20:00 ~ 08:00 
       Weekends: 22:00 ~ 10:00 
    - 'Rare' grade costumes was added on rewards of Zombie Defense[Hard]
    - (Bug fix) Ladder rank mark's wrong display bug was fixed.

notes.title: Patch Note of January 13th 2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603447/08cb5cee851265174f4d7c9a4200387f03e20bf8.png[/img]Content:

● Christmas event closing
- Contents regarding to previous event was removed. 
- 'Christmas Costume Package' was removed from item shop. 

● New Year Event 
- Players are able to collect 'New Year Coin' via Log-in Event, and can exchange with various items from Zone6 NPC Michael Snyder. Please check what Michael has prepared! 

● Welcoming New player Event
- During the event promotion, new players who joined after January 13th will receive 'Welcome Box' via Shared account mail. (Contains EXP +50%, Zen +50%, Special shop 7days, Normal Arcade Tickets, Lifes, Long Board 15Days.)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603447/45da540c4622f4aba2b767d082b915c70e9a1774.jpg[/img]
● New items
- [Limited sale] Green Cat Costume Set - Only purchasable one time per a character. - 2200 Cash
- [Limited sale] Starter Kit - Only purchasable one time per a character. - 990 Cash

● Every Cash Costume is now Tradeable.

● New 8 skills added on Kungfu class. 
- To every Kungfu class characters new skill boxes has been delivered. 
- New skills are available from Kungfu Skill Scroll(Random box)


● New <Season 1> begins
- Ladder and Arcade Ranking will be reset Every 3 months (may be subject to change about period)
- Previous Ladder point and Arcade Ranking will be all reset.

<Ladder>
- There will be special reward that only acquirable from Ladder season reward to Rank1, 2, 3, and according by ladder grade players will get different items at the end of the season. 
- Ladder point will be valid only in current season and will be reset after the season close. 
- Only able to get from match set as 'Auto team balance'. 
- Players of ladder 5 or below will not lose point from defeated matches. 
- Gaining points will be different according to opposite team's average ladder. 

<Arcade>
- There will be special reward according by Arcade Ranking at the end of the season. 
- Arcade Rank will be reset after the season close. 

● Official Controller(Game pad) Support
- Playing with Controller is now available! 
- Steam Controller, Xbox Controller 

● IP Block lifted in Southeast Asia region
- Players from Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Vietnam can join Zone4 G&G and Steam now. 

● Bug fix
- Stat description in some of upgraded skill's tooltip
- Other minor bug fix. 

● Compensation of connection issue
- Triple metal drill (3) was delivered to all players who has logged on game in last 7days.

Zone4 Team.

notes.title: Patch notes Dec 6th, 2016
notes.notes:
Greetings Fighters,

We could complete the maintenance properly earlier than we've expected.  
Everyone can log back in now, and please be informed below patch notes.

Thank you.


[b] Patch notes Dec 6 2016 [/b]

Contents:

[*] New Quest.
• Added a quest(Tutorial) about buying skills from NPC Dr.K
• when reach lvl 10, players are able to get the quest after completing ‘About Skill Upgrade’ quest. 
[i]    - Quest title: ‘How to get skill?
    - Summary:  Buy a Class skill box from Randy Heart.
    - Reward:  2,400 EXP, 5,000 Zen, 3 Class skill boxes. [/i]

[*] "Store" added on NPC
[Zone6] next to Hunting field, "Store" was added on NPC ‘Emma Momsen’ 
    → Able to buy Red Potion, Blue Potion, Board Box.

[*] Bugs fix
(1) Hide UI hotkey 
 Hide UI Hotkey was set as [F12] instead of [F9]
    → Fixed to: if click [F9] key Hide UI is available. 
(2) Item error
 Some of Orb marble doesn’t work. 
    → Fixed.
(3) [Unique Samurai] Set bonus’s description error 
 [Unique Samurai] Set bonus’s description doesn’t state correctly.
    →  Fixed description to actual adding stats
(4) Obtainable Zen from Zombie Defense 
 Over gaining Zen from Zombie Defense than intended
    →  Fixed to: Adjusted to suitable amount Zen, and players are able to get more EXP by a number of party members. 
(5)  Certain class cannot use Skill box (Quest)
  Ninja, Kungfu Class couldn’t use Skill Box (Quest) 
     → Fixed. 
(6)  Protected Stone Error
  When upgrading skills to +3 Protection stone didn’t work properly.
    → Fixed.

notes.title: Patch notes Dec 6th, 2016
notes.notes:
Greetings Fighters,

We could complete the maintenance properly earlier than we've expected.  
Everyone can log back in now, and please be informed below patch notes.

Thank you.


[b] Patch notes Dec 6 2016 [/b]

Contents:

[*] New Quest.
• Added a quest(Tutorial) about buying skills from NPC Dr.K
• when reach lvl 10, players are able to get the quest after completing ‘About Skill Upgrade’ quest. 
[i]    - Quest title: ‘How to get skill?
    - Summary:  Buy a Class skill box from Randy Heart.
    - Reward:  2,400 EXP, 5,000 Zen, 3 Class skill boxes. [/i]

[*] "Store" added on NPC
[Zone6] next to Hunting field, "Store" was added on NPC ‘Emma Momsen’ 
    → Able to buy Red Potion, Blue Potion, Board Box.

[*] Bugs fix
(1) Hide UI hotkey 
 Hide UI Hotkey was set as [F12] instead of [F9]
    → Fixed to: if click [F9] key Hide UI is available. 
(2) Item error
 Some of Orb marble doesn’t work. 
    → Fixed.
(3) [Unique Samurai] Set bonus’s description error 
 [Unique Samurai] Set bonus’s description doesn’t state correctly.
    →  Fixed description to actual adding stats
(4) Obtainable Zen from Zombie Defense 
 Over gaining Zen from Zombie Defense than intended
    →  Fixed to: Adjusted to suitable amount Zen, and players are able to get more EXP by a number of party members. 
(5)  Certain class cannot use Skill box (Quest)
  Ninja, Kungfu Class couldn’t use Skill Box (Quest) 
     → Fixed. 
(6)  Protected Stone Error
  When upgrading skills to +3 Protection stone didn’t work properly.
    → Fixed.
